description: Spec 016 T009: the pilot of the whole-period model on a T4 (research R7, R10): the real architecture (8 layers, width 256, 8 heads, 240 tokens of 6 five-second rows, non-causal, manoeuvre logit), one segment of at most 50 minutes (an hour with the start-up allowance). Measures periods per second and gives a loss curve; 6,000 updates of 256 periods complete inside the limit only above about 510 periods a second, otherwise the limit stops it. Not a training run: its weights are not carried.
